data.long_meaning: Gayathri is a name of the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who represents knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Gayathrika is derived from the Gayathri mantra, which is recited daily by Hindus as a prayer for enlightenment and knowledge. The name Gayathrika carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom and Virtue” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gayathrika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and virtue and live with faith, good character and purpose.
